description: Turn on egress control (or strengthen it). mode="review" prompts on unknown hosts; mode="block" hard-blocks them. Monotonic — it only ever ADDS protection and never reduces it (a request for review will not downgrade an existing block). Only adds protection, so it is always allowed over MCP.

mode.description: Enforcement to apply. "review" = prompt, "block" = deny. Defaults to review.

name: node9_egress_protect
